== Summary ==
[[Kevin Jaap]] holds up the "Grandezza – Zu Den Vier Winden, 2024" banner: a portrait card for each player, by 1 of 1 Chase Collectibles and Dragon Foilz.

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Kevin Jaap]]: face match with his [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg|Hall of Fame photo]], where he wears the same white polo.
